watch_company.eventDescription: One company that appeared in the EDGAR window but did not meet the accumulation bar (no qualifying insider open-market buys, or a bearish risk flag such as bankruptcy, delisting, or a non-reliance restatement voided the thesis). Includes the conviction score, any 8-K catalysts, and risk flags.

accumulation_company.eventDescription: One company with at least one insider open-market buy and a conviction score of 40 or higher. Includes insider buy value, cluster-buy flag, top buyers, 8-K catalysts, and the 0-100 conviction score.

high_conviction_company.eventDescription: One company scoring 70 or higher with a cluster buy (two or more distinct insiders buying on the open market) AND at least one material 8-K catalyst, with no bearish risk flag. The strongest accumulation signal. Includes full insider buyer detail, catalyst breakdown, and optional hiring momentum. First 3 high-conviction rows per run are free so you can validate output.
